settings.org.printLogo.label: Print the logo on invoices, credit notes and packing slips
settings.org.printLogo.title: Logo on documents
settings.org.requiredNames.notice: An invoice printing in a checked language cannot be issued while any of its items has no name in it. Unchecked, a missing name prints as the product’s own.
settings.org.requiredNames.title: Product names required on invoices
settings.org.tax.help: GST/HST, VAT, ABN — as issued. Leave blank if not registered.
settings.org.tax.label: Tax registration number
settings.org.tax.title: Tax registration
settings.org.timeZone.help: Where the business is. It decides the organization’s day: when a licence has expired, the date on packing slips, purchase orders and returns, what Home counts as overdue, and the date each export is named by.
settings.org.timeZone.newToday: The organization’s today becomes {date}. Licences, Home and new documents follow it from the moment you save.
settings.org.timeZone.screens: Times on screen still show in each person’s own time zone. Changing this never changes a document already printed.
settings.org.timeZone.stillUtc: Still on UTC, the time zone every organization started with. Choose where the business is: in the Americas, UTC is already tomorrow in the evening.
settings.org.timeZone.title: Time zone
settings.rates.howMany: How many {base} one {currency} is worth that day.
settings.rates.intro: What one unit of another currency is worth in your base currency, day by day. A purchase priced in that currency is valued at the latest rate on or before the day it arrived. Correcting a rate changes nothing already valued.
settings.rates.noBase: Set a base currency on the <link>Organization</link> page first — a rate converts into it.
settings.security.afterHelp: Only real use counts as activity.
settings.security.everyone: Everyone: for rules that ask every session to end after inactivity
settings.security.intro: For computers several people share. Off keeps today’s sessions: seven days idle.
settings.security.note: A minute before, people see a warning with “Stay signed in”. It can only shorten a session, never lengthen it.
settings.security.title: Sign out after inactivity
settings.security.unticked: Only sign-ins without “Keep me signed in”: the shared computers, where people untick it
settings.tax.charges.help: Each is charged on the same amount. Leave none for a code that charges nothing.
settings.tax.charges.title: Taxes it charges
settings.tax.empty: No tax codes yet. Invoices cannot be issued until each line has one — add the taxes you charge, and an Exempt code for items you do not tax.
settings.tax.inUse: In use — retired codes stay on invoices that used them
settings.tax.intro: Every invoice line carries one. A code can charge two taxes on the same amount, like GST and PST together; a code that charges nothing is Exempt. Changing a rate only affects invoices issued afterwards — issued ones keep the rate they were issued with.
settings.tax.name.help: What the invoice line shows: GST, GST + PST (BC), Exempt.
status.crash.message: This page stopped working. Reloading usually fixes it. If it happens again, send the reference below.
status.forbidden.title: You don't have access to this
status.missing.message: It may have been removed, or the link may be wrong.
status.missing.person: This person isn’t in your organization
status.notFound.message: There is no page at this address. It may have moved, or the link may be wrong.
status.notFound.signedOut: There is no page at this address. If a colleague sent you this link, sign in first and open it again.
status.notFound.title: Page not found
status.offline.message: Your connection or the server is down for the moment. Nothing you entered is lost; try again in a minute.
status.offline.title: Can't reach the server
timeZones.label: {zone} ({city})
unsaved.title: Leave without saving?
